rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a sudden, rapid attack or raid.

example.english: The enemy planned to blitz our camp under cover of darkness.
example.traditional: 敵軍打算趁天黑突襲我哋嘅營地。
example.jyutping: dik6 gwan1 daa2 syun3 can3 tin1 hak1 dat6 zaap6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 jing4 dei6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a swift, forceful campaign or offensive, including a publicity campaign.

example.english: The company launched a major blitz to promote its new phone.
example.traditional: 公司為宣傳新手機發動強大攻勢。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 wai6 syun1 cyun4 san1 sau2 gei1 faat3 dung6 koeng4 daai6 gung1 sai3

rows.note: Use this for the sudden attack or intensive operation side of a blitz, rather than a sustained campaign such as a publicity blitz.

example.english: The troops will carry out a blitz tonight and catch the enemy off guard.
example.traditional: 部隊今晚會進行突擊行動，打敵人一個措手不及。
example.jyutping: bou6 deoi2 gam1 maan1 wui5 zeon3 hang4 dat6 gik1 hang4 dung6 daa2 dik6 jan4 jat1 go3 cou3 sau2 bat1 kap6

rows.note: Use this specifically for an air raid, especially when referring to the historical Blitz.

example.english: During the Second World War, London was often hit by the Blitz.
example.traditional: 二戰期間，倫敦經常受到空襲。
example.jyutping: ji6 zin3 kei4 gaan1 leon4 deon1 ging1 soeng4 sau6 dou3 hung1 zaap6
